title: Complete toric coefficient models and rational facet notation
statement:
Let $P$ be a commutative monoid, written additively (in the use made of it, $P$ is finitely generated, integral, saturated [def-trf-fs-log-blowup] and sharp), and let $n\geq0$ be an integer. For a commutative ring $L$, $L[P][t_1,\ldots,t_n]$ is the polynomial ring in $t_1,\ldots,t_n$ over the monoid ring $L[P]$, whose elements are finite sums of $c z^q t^e$ with $q\in P$, $e\in\mathbf N^n$, $c\in L$, and $z^qz^{q'}=z^{q+q'}$. Its chart ideal is $(z^q\ (q
eq0),t_1,\ldots,t_n)$. If $L$ is local with maximal ideal $\mathfrak m_L$, the complete model $B_L(P,n)$ is the adic completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] of $L[P][t_1,\ldots,t_n]$ at the ideal $(\mathfrak m_L,z^q\ (q
eq0),t_1,\ldots,t_n)$; the chart monomial $z^q\in B_L(P,n)$ is the image of $z^q$, and the completed chart ideal is the ideal of $B_L(P,n)$ generated by the image of the chart ideal. A commutative ring $R$ with a map $z:P	o R$ is a complete toric model of $(P,n)$ if there is a ring isomorphism carrying the chart monomials to $z$ from either (i) $B_k(P,n)$ for a field $k$, or (ii) $B_C(P,n)/(	heta)$, where $C$ is a Cohen ring of residue characteristic $p$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring] and $	heta\in B_C(P,n)$ satisfies $	heta-p\in(z^q\ (q
eq0),t_1,\ldots,t_n)B_C(P,n)$. Let $G=P^{m gp}$ be the group completion [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], written additively, with $q\mapsto[q]$; let $V=G\otimes_{\mathbf Z}\mathbf Q$, and let $\sigma\subset V$ be the cone of nonnegative rational combinations of the images $[q]\otimes1$, $q\in P$. A facet of $\sigma$ is a subset $F=\sigma\cap\ker h$ for a nonzero $\mathbf Q$-linear form $h:V	o\mathbf Q$ nonnegative on $\sigma$, such that the linear span of $F$ has dimension $\dim V-1$. A $\mathbf Q$-linear $h:V	o\mathbf Q$ is the rational extension of a homomorphism $
u:G	o\mathbf Z$ if $h(g\otimes1)=
u(g)$ for all $g\in G$. A primitive normal of a facet $F$ is a surjective homomorphism $
u:G	o\mathbf Z$ with $
u([q])\geq0$ for all $q\in P$ whose rational extension $h$ satisfies $F=\sigma\cap\ker h$. For a ring $R$ with $z:P	o R$ and a facet $F$, the boundary ideal is $\mathfrak p_F=(z(q):q\in P,\ [q]\otimes1
otin F)R$.

source.place: Exposé VI 1.6(i)--(ii), printed p. 70, for the complete models $B_k(P,n)$ and $B_C(P,n)/(\theta)$; the lattice, rational cone, facet, primitive-normal and boundary-ideal notation is the statement notation of lem-trf-complete-toric-facet-valuations (agent-formulated auxiliary input, motivated by ILO VI 1.4 and 1.6, printed pp. 69--70).
